corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez root text clearly uses the round ፅ (ወወፅአ) as in Col 2 L04 and Col 4 L15, rather than ጽ.
Classical Ge'ez preposition + demonstrative 'ወእምዝ' ('and after this') is printed with 6th-order እ (confirmed also by the citation in Col 4 L26), which was misread as 1st-order አ.
Visual inspection of Col 3 L08 shows two-legged ሰ in ወቀሰመ (matching ወቅስም in Col 2 L28) and round ፀ in ዐፀደ (matching ለዐፀደ in Col 2 L28).
The causative verb form 'ባስፈጁ' ('when he had them slaughtered') is printed with 6th-order ስ (bent left leg), misread as 1st-order ሰ.
